---
title: "[feature] Add staged deposit schedule option"
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

Some larger jobs benefit from a staged deposit schedule (e.g., 30% at signing, 30% at midpoint, 40% at completion) rather than the current 50% deposit + balance structure.

**What I'd want**

- A deposit schedule dropdown in the Quote sheet
- Auto-generated terms text based on the chosen schedule

**Why**

For larger new-build installs ($10k+), customers sometimes ask for a staged deposit. Having it as an option makes the quote builder more flexible.
